_comment: Answer overrides where the source key file is wrong (each verified by re-derivation + zoom-crop; most also book-solution-backed). Content fix applied directly in questions.json (not an override): Q2112 stem '[f(3) - f(2)]/11' -> '[f(3) + f(2)]/11' (with minus the value 19/11 is not an option; with plus it is 33/11 = 3 = key C).

2127.reason: key 'a' wrong: range of (x^2-x+1)/(x^2+x+1) via discriminant of (y-1)x^2+(y+1)x+(y-1)=0 is [1/3, 3] = option D

2129.reason: key 'a' wrong: domain needs 2x-3>0 (from log) and 5-2x>=0, giving (3/2, 5/2] = option D (book's own working agrees)

2170.reason: key 'a' wrong: fog(x) = f(x^(1/3)) = 8(x^(1/3))^3 = 8x = option C (book's own working writes 8x)

2202.reason: key 'b' wrong: period of |sin x + cos x| is pi (the absolute value halves the 2pi period) = option D

2209.reason: key 'c' wrong: period of sin(x/2) is 4pi, of cos(x/3) is 6pi; LCM = 12pi = option D

2211.reason: key 'c' wrong: 2sin3θ+4cos3θ = R sin(3θ+φ) has period 2pi/3; the absolute value halves it to pi/3 = option D

2212.reason: key 'd' wrong: sin^4 x + cos^4 x = 3/4 + (1/4)cos4x, period of cos4x = 2pi/4 = pi/2 = option A
